takes.title: Walk with Stiff Arms and Wide Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks forward with a relatively rigid upper body, low arms, and feet set wider on several steps. The take ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Take Short Stiff Steps with Side-to-Side Sway
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short steps with the arms held low, shifting the upper body over each foot. They remain in motion at the end.

takes.title: Step into a Forward Kick
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps from standing, lifts one leg forward with the knee extending, then lowers it and takes a recovery step.

takes.title: Turn through a High Knee Lift and Kick
takes.actionDescription: The performer turns while stepping, opens the arms for balance, lifts a knee and extends the leg, then returns upright.

takes.title: Lift a Knee into a Kick and Step Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins upright, lifts one knee during a short kicking motion, and steps out with both arms low.

takes.title: Kick Forward and Settle into Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer winds up with a small weight shift, lifts and extends one leg forward, and returns it to a narrow standing stance.

takes.title: Rise from a Crouch with a Diagonal Arm Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with knees deeply bent and one hand near the head, then straightens and reaches diagonally upward with one leg extended behind.

takes.title: Rise from a Low Crouch and Hold a Side Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins low with one arm near the head, straightens the legs into a side lean, and holds the raised-arm pose at the end.

takes.title: Hold a Bent-Knee Twisted Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer stays in a bent-knee pose with the arms offset in front, changing little from the opening to the finish.
takes.reviewNote: Source description is Unknown. The front-quarter frames appear nearly static in a diagonal pose. Review the root path and side camera before choosing a more specific interpretation.

takes.title: Lean Forward to Peer and Hold
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, then tilts the torso forward, extends one leg back, and pauses in the leaning position.

takes.title: Step Wide and Hold an Outward Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with forearms close, steps into a wider stance, and extends one hand while the other stays near the body.

takes.title: Hold a Low Crouch and Lean Forward
takes.actionDescription: The performer stays in a deep crouch, then tilts the head and torso forward while keeping the arms close. The take ends low.

takes.title: Move through a Full-Body Range-of-Motion Sequence
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises and lowers the arms, shifts weight through leg movements, and finishes with both arms extended to the sides.

takes.title: Walk with a Slightly Forward Stance on a Slope
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, takes several strides with a slight forward tilt, and returns to a narrow stance. The source identifies a slope.

takes.title: Take Measured Steps along a Slope
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes a short series of measured steps with low arms, then settles upright. The source identifies a slope.

takes.title: Walk with Brief High Steps on a Slope
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with low arms and lifts the feet higher through the middle of the take before returning upright.

takes.title: Walk with a Pronounced Knee Lift on a Slope
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes a few forward steps, adds a higher knee lift near the middle, and finishes in a narrow upright stance.

takes.title: Take Short Uphill-Style Steps with Arms Low
takes.actionDescription: The performer leans slightly forward and takes a sequence of short steps, with the heels lifting visibly behind. The source identifies a slope.

takes.title: Walk with a Forward Tilt and High Heel Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps with a forward lean and alternates lifting the heels, then straightens into a narrow stance.

takes.title: Walk Stiffly with Long, Wide Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with a relatively stiff upper body and several wide steps, with arms hanging low. The final pose is nearly upright with the feet closer.
